title: ShipperInvoice
description: A Shipper invoice (Canonical Model document, version 1): the ERP's invoice to one Shipper over its Billable lines, one line per Transport Order, issued by an Invoice run. Final once issued; corrections are Credit notes. The ERP, which owns Shipper invoices, shows it and publishes it in ShipperInvoiceIssued.

invoiceNumber.description: INV-<year>-<6 digits>, from a gapless sequence per calendar year, taken only in the transaction that issues the invoice.

invoiceDate.description: The date of the Invoice run, Europe/Amsterdam.

shipper.description: The Shipper invoiced, from the ERP's seed-loaded Shipper data.

shipperReference.description: The Shipper's own reference for the Transport Order.

shipmentNumber.description: Kept on the line for Finance. It isn't sent to the Shipper (ADR 0011).

deliveryDate.description: The day the Shipment was Delivered, where it happened.

total.description: The sum of the charge lines, without VAT.

totalWithoutVat.description: The sum of the line totals.

vat.description: 21% of the total without VAT, rounded to cents, half away from zero.

totalWithVat.description: The total without VAT and the VAT added up.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID the ERP created for this invoice.

status.description: Issued, final; Sent once the Shipper invoice Logic App reported the Shipper's endpoint acknowledged it, or NotDelivered once it reported the invoice never reached the Shipper. Finance sending a NotDelivered invoice again makes it Issued once more.

sentAt.description: When the invoice was reported Sent. Absent while it is Issued only.

notDelivered.description: Why the invoice never reached the Shipper. Present only while the status is NotDelivered.

statusCode.description: The Shipper endpoint's HTTP status code; null when the failure had none, such as a timeout.

message.description: The technical cause in plain language.
